propositions.name: aether_pervaded_by_electrons
propositions.statement: The material system consists of free aether pervaded by a system of electrons, some of them free or isolated and the great majority grouped into material molecules.
propositions.quote: the material system as consisting of free aether pervaded by a system of electrons which are to be treated individually, some of them free or isolated

propositions.name: electrons_grouped_into_molecules
propositions.statement: The great majority of electrons are grouped into material molecules.
propositions.quote: but the great majority of them grouped into material molecules

propositions.name: material_system_may_lack_or_have_motion_through_aether
propositions.statement: A material system may be devoid of translatory motion through the aether, or a translatory velocity may be superposed on it.
propositions.quote: a material system devoid of translatory motion through the aether, with what it would be when a translatory velocity is superposed

propositions.name: aether_equations_ascertained_independently
propositions.statement: The dynamical equations of the free aether have been ascertained in independent ways from consideration of both the optical side and the electrodynamic side of its activity.
propositions.quote: whose dynamical equations have been definitely ascertained in quite independent ways from consideration of both the optical side and the electrodynamic side of its activity

propositions.name: electron_is_singular_point
propositions.statement: An electron occurs as a singular point in the aether, on approaching which the elastic strain constituting the aethereal displacement increases indefinitely.
propositions.quote: An electron e will occur in this analysis as a singular point in the aether, on approaching which the elastic strain constituting the aethereal displacement

propositions.name: singularity_is_definite_transferable_structure
propositions.statement: The singularity at an electron represents a definite structure, a nucleus of strain in the aether, capable of transference across the aether independently of motion of the aether itself.
propositions.quote: this singularity represents a definite structure, forming a nucleus of strain in the aether, which is capable of transference across that medium independently of motion of the aether itself

propositions.name: strain_carried_along_with_electron
propositions.statement: The portion of aethereal strain associated with an electron is carried along with the electron in its motion.
propositions.quote: which is associated with the electron and is carried along with the electron in its motion

propositions.name: energy_concentrated_around_nucleus
propositions.statement: The energy of the aethereal displacement associated with an electron is closely concentrated around the nucleus of the electron and not widely diffused.
propositions.quote: the energy of this part of the displacement is closely concentrated around the nucleus of the electron, and not widely diffused as might at first sight appear

propositions.name: electrons_analogous_to_sources_and_sinks
propositions.statement: Electrons are analogous to the sources and sinks of the abstract theory of liquid flow.
propositions.quote: these are analogous to the so-called sources and sinks in the abstract theory of liquid flow

propositions.name: displacement_flux_equals_electron_quantity
propositions.statement: When electrons are present, the integral of the normal component of the aethereal displacement over the boundary of any region equals the quantity of electrons existing in the region.
propositions.quote: the integral of the normal component of the aethereal displacement over the boundary of any region, instead of being null, is equal to the quantity

propositions.name: magnetic_induction_has_no_simple_poles
propositions.statement: The magnetic induction possesses the stream property, but singular points of the nature of simple poles do not exist in its distribution.
propositions.quote: the magnetic induction ( a, b, c ), also possesses the stream property; but singular points in its distribution, of the nature of simple poles, do not exist

propositions.name: moving_electron_produces_rotational_singularity
propositions.statement: The motion of an electron involves a singularity in the magnetic induction of a rotational type, with its nucleus at the moving electron.
propositions.quote: The motion of an electron involves however a singularity in ( a, b, c ), of a rotational type, with its nucleus at the moving electron

propositions.name: orbital_electron_equivalent_to_magnetic_doublet
propositions.statement: The time-average of the rotational singularity of a rapid steady orbital motion of an electron is, at distances considerable compared with the orbit, equivalent to a magnetic doublet.
propositions.quote: is analytically equivalent, at distances considerable compared with the dimensions of the orbit, to a magnetic doublet analogous to a source and associated equal sink

propositions.name: aether_parts_sensibly_at_rest
propositions.statement: The various parts of the aether are supposed to be sensibly at rest.
propositions.quote: the various parts of the aether are supposed to be sensibly at rest

propositions.name: strain_rate_is_simple_time_differentiation
propositions.statement: The time-rate of change of the strain of any element of the aether is represented by differentiation with respect to the time without any additional terms for the element being carried to a new position.
propositions.quote: the time-rate of change of the strain of any element of the aether is represented by differentiation with respect to the time without any additional terms

propositions.name: aether_equations_are_linear
propositions.statement: The equations of the aether are much simpler than those of the dynamics of fluid motion, being in fact linear.
propositions.quote: the equations of the aether are much simpler than those of the dynamics of fluid motion, being in fact linear

propositions.name: aether_stagnant_bodies_flit_through_without_flow
propositions.statement: The aether is stagnant, while the molecules constituting the Earth and all other material bodies flit through it without producing any finite flow in it.
propositions.quote: The aether is stagnant on this theory, while the molecules constituting the Earth and all other material bodies flit through it without producing any finite flow in it

propositions.name: aberration_and_doppler_hold
propositions.statement: The law of the astronomical aberration of light is rigorously maintained, and the Doppler change of wave-length of radiation from a moving source holds good.
propositions.quote: the law of the astronomical aberration of light is rigorously maintained, and the Doppler change of wave-length of radiation from a moving source holds good

propositions.name: terrestrial_optical_phenomena_unaffected_by_earths_motion
propositions.statement: All purely terrestrial optical phenomena are unaffected by the Earth's motion.
propositions.quote: all purely terrestrial optical phenomena are unaffected by the Earth's motion

propositions.name: c_is_single_physical_constant_of_aether
propositions.statement: c is the single physical constant of the aether, being the velocity of propagation of elastic disturbances through it.
propositions.quote: c is the single physical constant of the aether, being the velocity of propagation of elastic disturbances through it

propositions.name: electric_and_optical_media_share_equations
propositions.statement: The equations for the electric medium are the same as the equations for the dynamics of optical media.
propositions.quote: they are the same as the equations arrived at by MacCullagh a quarter of a century earlier in his formulation of the dynamics of optical media

propositions.name: electron_has_permanence_and_free_mobility
propositions.statement: An electron has permanence and characteristic properties and free mobility through the aether.
propositions.quote: the permanence and characteristic properties of an electron and its free mobility through the aether

propositions.name: state_at_later_time_determined_by_initial_state
propositions.statement: From a knowledge of the state of the system at any time, the state at a later time can be immediately expressed by successive steps.
propositions.quote: from a knowledge of the state of the system at any time t the state at the time t + δt can be immediately expressed

propositions.name: electron_nucleus_labile_no_inertia
propositions.statement: The nucleus of the electron is labile as regards displacement through the aether, its movement not influenced by any inertia or forces except its relation to the aether.
propositions.quote: its movement is not influenced by any inertia or forces except such as are the expression of its relation to the aether

propositions.name: electrons_treated_as_points
propositions.statement: So long as the dimensions of electron nuclei are extremely small compared with the distances between them, it suffices for the theory to consider them as points.
propositions.quote: so long as the actual dimensions of their nuclei are extremely small in comparison with the distances between them, it will suffice for the theory to consider them as points

propositions.name: atoms_are_aggregations_of_electrons_with_only_electric_forces
propositions.statement: Atoms of matter are constituted of aggregations of electrons, and the only actions between atoms are what may be described as electric forces.
propositions.quote: atoms of matter are constituted of aggregations of electrons, the only actions between atoms are what may be described as electric forces

propositions.name: atom_possesses_vortex_ring_dynamical_properties
propositions.statement: The atom of matter possesses all the dynamical properties of a vortex ring in a frictionless fluid.
propositions.quote: the atom of matter possesses all the dynamical properties of a vortex ring in a frictionless fluid

propositions.name: observer_may_move_uniformly_through_stationary_aether
propositions.statement: Phenomena are examined for how they are altered when the observer and his apparatus are in uniform motion through the stationary aether.
propositions.quote: to examine how phenomena are altered when the observer and his apparatus are in uniform motion through the stationary aether

propositions.name: corresponding_electrons_occupy_corresponding_positions
propositions.statement: The electrons in the two compared systems, situated at the singular points at which the concentration of the electric displacement ceases to vanish, occupy corresponding positions.
propositions.quote: the electrons in the two systems here compared, being situated at the singular points at which the concentration of the electric displacement ceases to vanish, occupy corresponding positions

propositions.name: corresponding_electrons_have_equal_strengths
propositions.statement: The corresponding electrons in the fixed and moving systems are of equal strengths, since very near an electron the values of the displacement and induction are practically those due to it alone.
propositions.quote: these electrons are of equal strengths: for, very near an electron, fixed or moving, the values of ( f, g, h ) and ( a, b, c ) are practically those due to it

propositions.name: transformation_applies_to_any_isotropic_dielectric
propositions.statement: The analytical transformation of the equations applies to any isotropic dielectric medium as well as to free aether, altering c into the velocity of radiation in that medium.
propositions.quote: the above analytical transformation of the equations applies to any isotropic dielectric medium as well as to free aether: we have only to alter c into the velocity of radiation in that medium

propositions.name: motion_of_polarized_dielectric_alters_current_type
propositions.statement: The motion of the polarized dielectric matter alters the mathematical type of the electric current.
propositions.quote: the motion of the polarized dielectric matter has altered the mathematical type of the electric current

propositions.name: no_direct_transformation_for_material_medium
propositions.statement: It is of no avail to try to effect a direct general transformation of equations of a material medium in which dielectric and conductive coefficients occur.
propositions.quote: It is thus of no avail to try to effect in this way a direct general transformation of equations of a material medium in which dielectric and conductive coefficients occur

propositions.name: steady_system_correspondence_simplifies
propositions.statement: The correspondence between a system referred to fixed axes and a system referred to moving axes assumes a simple aspect when the former system is a steady one, with variables independent of the time.
propositions.quote: The correspondence here established between a system referred to fixed axes and a system referred to moving axes will assume a very simple aspect when the former system is a steady one

propositions.name: identical_system_exists_in_uniform_motion
propositions.statement: Given any system of electrified bodies at rest in equilibrium under mutual electric influences and imposed constraints, there is a precisely identical system in equilibrium under the same constraints and in uniform translatory motion through the aether.
propositions.quote: given any system of electrified bodies at rest, in equilibrium under their mutual electric influences and imposed constraints, there will be a precisely identical system in equilibrium under the same constraints, and in uniform translatory motion through the aether

propositions.name: motion_does_not_alter_distributions_to_first_order
propositions.statement: Uniform translatory motion through the aether does not produce any alteration in electric distributions as far as the first order of the ratio of the velocity of the system to the velocity of radiation is concerned.
propositions.quote: uniform translatory motion through the aether does not produce any alteration in electric distributions as far as the first order of the ratio of the velocity of the system to the velocity of radiation is concerned

propositions.name: result_independent_of_theory_of_molecular_forces
propositions.statement: The result that motion does not alter electric distributions is independent of any theory of the forces between material molecules, the structure of the matter being assumed unaltered to the first order by motion through the aether.
propositions.quote: this result is independent of any theory as to the nature of the forces between material molecules: the structure of the matter being assumed unaltered to the first order by motion through the aether

propositions.name: natural_configuration_needs_no_new_forces_in_motion
propositions.statement: If a configuration of ionic charges is the natural one in a material system at rest, maintaining the same configuration in uniform motion will not require the aid of any new forces.
propositions.quote: if any configuration of ionic charges is the natural one in a material system at rest, the maintenance of the same configuration as regards the system in uniform motion will not require the aid of any new forces

propositions.name: electron_is_simple_singularity_on_any_theory
propositions.statement: The electron taken by itself must be, on any conceivable theory, a simple singularity of the aether.
propositions.quote: The electron taken by itself must be on any conceivable theory a simple singularity of the aether

propositions.name: fixed_and_moving_systems_identical_yet_displacements_differ
propositions.statement: The fixed and the moving system of electrons of this correlation are at corresponding instants identical, yet the electric and magnetic displacements belonging to them differ by terms of the first order.
propositions.quote: though the fixed and the moving system of electrons of this correlation are at corresponding instants identical, yet the electric and magnetic displacements belonging to them differ by terms of the first order
